tests.name: Source register separates 340 entered and 138 calculated fields
Independent synthetic geometry and cloth arithmetic
Exact bay lookups do not interpolate
Physical and wall-span widths are separate
Whole counts, missing input, zero denominator and excessive values block outputs
Standard and additional cut rounding retain different order
Wider sheet rejects negative offcuts and computes area and cutting length
Recovered motor thresholds are exact and preserve cable N/A
Later additional screens remain visible but omitted from legacy motor area
Wire, strainers, twine and clips follow independent arithmetic
Manual blank, zero and reason remain distinct
Changed inputs invalidate allowances without changing their values
Explicit scope exclusions suppress manual and bypassed rows while retaining originals
Six gates stay excluded until explicitly enabled
Gross margin, quoted FX and source rounding use explicit arithmetic
No-purchase remains priced and empty rate makes total unavailable
Installation is unavailable rather than silently zero
First snapshot preserves exact source evidence and fixed context
Rerun detects a saved manual edit and preserves original run
Removed manual line requires keep or remove disposition
Stale preview, reader, lock and cross-tab gates block writes
Precommit failure leaves the exact state intact
Lost-response recovery is idempotent and rechecks grants
Totals repair uses saved commercial input basis without regeneration
Backup restore validates context, units, quantities, rates and duplicate keys
Discount position cannot be manually adjusted independently of the price policy
Six-row cloth lookup is exact, including 5 m to 5.3 m
Default parameters reproduce every r02 quantity, total and torque in 28 scenarios
Catalogue identities are stable, complete and carry no prices or quote identifiers
Drive family resolves branch part numbers without reinterpreting stored diameters
Pinion tube and drive pipe diameters are separate recovered identities
Drive pipe diameter applies the recovered C102 rules for drums, protectors, sprockets and parts
Truss chord height selects the truss clip part without changing quantities
Roof profile is a drawing input with no source cell or quantity effect
Conflicts and unconfigured dependencies are never silently mapped
Saved lines keep the part number only and resolve descriptions when shown
Untested selections are counted, explained and never blocking
Tunable parameters are editable records that recalculate their consumers
Cable first-band torque result is a bound parameter
Parameter changes need a reason, respect write gates and invalidate allowances
Historical coverage uses the full comparison with recorded corrections
